slice: FULL SAIL Stage 1 NIGHTWATCH Ch4 Slice C1

findings.red: PR #707 independently reviewed shadow runtime treats EMAIL_OUTBOUND_RUNTIME_COMPOSITION_ENABLED=true as a global provider-capability refusal. Live Sunset staging already uses that exact flag for healthy staff/manual approve-send. Shadow readiness therefore cannot activate without disabling staff outbound.
findings.green: Provider-inert Luna shadow capture may be ready when EMAIL_OUTBOUND_RUNTIME_COMPOSITION_ENABLED=true because the shadow runtime has no provider capability and a separate Staff API lifecycle: dedicated worker DSN/session versus lazy per-request staff/manual outbound dispatch. Staff outbound remains the staff/manual path.

findings.red: Allowing staff outbound coexistence could be over-read as whole-process provider inertness, or as permission for LUNA_AUTO_SEND_ENABLED or shadow provider/send/journal activation.
findings.green: LUNA_AUTO_SEND_ENABLED remains a hard refusal, including when staff outbound composition is true. Shadow runtime cannot call provider/send/journal. Default-off and prior B8 DSN/session/scoped-claim/exact tenant-location-endpoint/one-replica gates remain. Claims are shadow-runtime provider inertness only; staff/manual outbound may exist in the same Staff API process.
